testRunner_comment: Same Phase 02 switch as packages/db/api/schemas: the vitest plugin's per-mutant runs complete zero tests under vitest 5.0.1 (see packages/db/stryker.conf.json for the analysis); the command runner relies on the vitest exit code instead.
concurrency_comment: Serial is mandatory here, not a performance choice (same finding as packages/db). With the Stryker command runner under vitest 5.0.1, parallel workers share one sandbox and cross-contaminate runs, and a mutant whose run hangs is scored as killed, so a parallel run can report a false high.
